description: One published page of www.techfabric.com as clean Markdown, with its title, search title (metaTitle), description, date, updated, author, tags, FAQs as question and answer pairs, and canonical URL. Takes a URL, a path or a post's slug. Only published, indexable pages. Drafts are private: list_drafts lists a signed-in engineer's drafts; a TechFabric engineer connects with Microsoft (the client's Connect or Authenticate button) to list and write them.

url_or_slug.description: A techfabric.com URL, a path such as /services/databricks, or a post's slug

name: get_page

markdown.description: The page as Markdown, without the site's navigation; a very long page is cut at a heading (truncated)

markdown_url.description: The whole page as Markdown, to fetch

metaTitle.description: The page's <title>, as search results show it

truncated.description: The page was longer than one result carries; markdown_url has all of it

title: Read a page
